ShortUrl.title: ShortUrl
ShortUrl.description: A shortened URL record mapping a unique code to an original destination URL.

id.description: Unique short code or custom alias (document ID).

ownerId.description: User ID of the creator if authenticated, or empty for guests.

title.description: Optional human-readable title for the link.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the short URL was created.

expiresAt.description: Optional ISO timestamp when the link expires.

clicks.description: Total number of times the short URL was accessed.

lastAccessedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the link was last accessed.

isCustomAlias.description: Whether a custom alias was specified.

password.description: Optional password / PIN protecting access to the redirect.

ClickLog.title: ClickLog
ClickLog.description: Individual click telemetry record storing device and browser analytics.

shortCode.description: The shortCode associated with this click.

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp when the click occurred.

browser.description: Detected web browser (e.g., Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge).

deviceType.description: Device category: Desktop, Mobile, or Tablet.

os.description: Operating system (e.g., Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, Linux).

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User account profile and link preferences.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user registered.

customDomain.description: Primary custom domain selected by the user.

CustomDomain.title: CustomDomain
CustomDomain.description: Custom branded vanity domain record with DNS verification instructions and status.

verificationToken.description: Unique challenge token for TXT verification.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when domain was registered.

verifiedAt.description: Optional ISO timestamp when verification passed.

isPrimary.description: Whether this domain is currently default for new links.

/urls/{shortCode}.description: Public lookup collection for short URL redirections and user link management.

/urls/{shortCode}/clicks/{clickId}.description: Detailed click telemetry logs for the short URL.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile documents accessible only by the owner.

/users/{userId}/domains/{domainId}.description: User's custom domain configurations and DNS verification status.
